title: Miummy!
description: Performance, practicity... Why choose when you can have both ?
body:
# **Performance meets Aesthetics** #

**Miummy!** is an extreme performance/Enhanced Vanilla modpack working on _Fabric_.

--------------------

**_NOTE: VOXY CHUNKS WON'T BE LOADED USING A SHADER!_**

--------------------


_How?:_ Thanks to the combination of **Sodium**,  **Lithium**, **FerriteCore** and many others.

_What performance to expect?:_ Extreme FPS and stability. **150 fps min** with Shaders, **220 fps min** without.

**Why choose "Miummy!"?:**

1: By using **Voxy + Bobby**, you can see chunks you've ALREADY LOADED up to 9000 blocks away. (Configurable)


![Voxy Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb96a74181866bdf636810e8192a7140c391aefc_0.webp)


2: The ****Texture packs**** have been __meticulously chosen__ for the best user experience. 
(ex: **Fresh animations, Vanilla experience +, Fullbright UB...**)

--------------------

### **Technical info**
**Memory:** __6__ to __8__ gb.

**Shaders:** _Complementary: Reimagined_ / None recommended. 

**_NOTE: VOXY CHUNKS WON'T BE LOADED USING A SHADER!_**

**Display:** Tested in _5120x1440p_ and _1920x1080p_, works really well.

--------------------

**_THE PACK IS STILL IN BETA. You may encounter bugs. I invite you to kindly report them on the modrinth page of the modpack._**
